ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Cook more than one kind of meal: bills for two or three kinds, or pemmican, berries or a fine meal in the mix. It eases as the meals change. A colony that can make only one kind feels it least, and ascetics don't mind.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Keep three or more kinds of food in the mix, a couple of days at a time.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: Give them a second kind of work in the Work tab, even a few hours a day. One varied day ends the run. Industrious and hard-working colonists, and anyone with a burning passion for the work, don't mind.
It ends when they're together again. Keep trips short, or send the two of them together.
A bigger room, more seats at the tables, or meals and recreation spread over the day in the schedule. It fades half a day after the crush. Parties and meetings don't count.
Finish the frames that are waiting (often for materials), or cancel what you don't need. Untouched plans count for much less than half-built work. Lazy colonists and slobs don't care.
